decisions.headline: 《露玛岛》PS5、Xbox Series版定于12月2日，支持跨平台4人联机
decisions.summary: Feel Free Games 宣布《露玛岛》将于12月2日登陆 PS5 与 Xbox Series，定价19.99美元；主机版加入完整跨平台多人功能，最多4名玩家可在 PS5、Xbox Series 与 PC 之间共同耕作、制作和探索。
decisions.verification: Gematsu 已打开并明确转述开发商 Feel Free Games 的公告，核实12月2日主机版日期、19.99美元定价及最多4人的跨平台多人功能。
decisions.reason: 可靠媒体明确转述可识别的开发商公告，主体、固定窗口与主机移植核心事实完整。

entries.headline: Luma Island comes to PS5 and Xbox Series on December 2 with four-player cross-platform multiplayer
entries.summary: Feel Free Games says Luma Island will launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series on December 2 for $19.99. The console release adds full cross-platform multiplayer for up to four players across PS5, Xbox Series, and PC.
entries.verification: Gematsu explicitly relays Feel Free Games’ announcement, confirming the December 2 console date, $19.99 price, and four-player cross-platform multiplayer.
